description:
Retrieves the DAG source code from a Managed Airflow environment.

Use this tool when you want to understand DAG implementation details, for example to
understand why a DAG run has failed, or to debug DAG's behavior. The tool returns the latest
version of the source code.

environment.description: Required. The name of the environment. Format: `projects/{projectId}/locations/{locationId}/environments/{environmentId}`

name: get_dag_source_code

outputSchema.description: A source code of a DAG.

code.description: The source code of the user-defined DAG.
